zh: 一手握住对侧前臂，双脚站稳。
活动侧肘向后拉，另一手提供轻微阻力，然后交换侧。
en: Hold the opposite forearm and stand steadily.
Draw the working elbow back against gentle resistance from the other hand, then switch sides.

zh: 保持自然呼吸，只使用能够稳定控制的幅度和轻阻力。
出现不舒服或支撑不稳时停止；使用前检查器械和固定点。
en: Breathe normally and use only a range and light resistance you can control.
Stop if uncomfortable or unstable; check equipment and anchors before use.

Bend the elbows to lower through a controlled range, then press back up; stop if your knuckles are uncomfortable.

Stop if uncomfortable or unstable; check equipment and anchors before use.

zh: 站直，双手在身前相扣，手臂抬至约肩高。
下巴轻向胸前收，双手向前伸，让上背轻轻圆起，肩胛向两侧分开。
保持 15–30 秒后放松，重复 2–4 次。
en: Stand upright and link your hands in front of you, with your arms near shoulder level.
Ease your chin down and reach away from your body, rounding the upper back and spreading the shoulder blades.
Stay for 15–30 seconds, release, and complete 2–4 repetitions.

zh: 如出现疼痛，减小幅度或停止。
en: Ease off or stop if pain develops.

contentSource.title: Healthy Upper Back: Exercises
contentSource.section: Lower neck and upper back (rhomboid) stretch

name.zh: 扶稳固支撑物宽站距静态站立

zh: 站在稳固墙面、椅背或台面旁，双脚以宽站距着地，手始终轻扶支撑物。
保持双脚着地和身体站稳，目视前方，自然呼吸；不抬脚、不踮脚、不踏步。
en: Stand beside a solid wall, stable chair back or sturdy counter with both feet on the floor in a wide stance. Keep a hand in contact with the support throughout.
Keep both feet grounded and hold a steady standing position while looking ahead and breathing naturally. Do not lift a foot, raise your heels or step.

zh: 保持自然呼吸，只使用能够稳定控制的幅度和轻阻力。
出现不舒服或支撑不稳时停止；使用前检查器械和固定点。
en: Breathe normally and use only a range and light resistance you can control.
Stop if uncomfortable or unstable; check equipment and anchors before use.

contentSource: older.balance.progression stage 1; user approved supported wide static stand

zh: 慢慢原地踏步，脚轻轻离地，膝盖不用抬高，手臂自然摆动。需要的话可以扶着墙或椅背。
en: Step slowly in place, lifting your feet just off the floor. No need to raise your knees high; let your arms swing naturally. Hold a wall or chair back if you like.

contentSource: User-approved product decision: slow walking in place, low-intensity walking locomotion; coach review pending. ACOG Exercise After Pregnancy and Committee Opinion 804 are general postpartum background only, not specific endorsement of this action or uncleared cesarean exercise. https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/exercise-after-pregnancy https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/committee-opinion/articles/2020/04/physical-activity-and-exercise-during-pregnancy-and-the-postpartum-period

zh: 从战士二式开始：双脚前后分开，前膝弯曲在脚踝正上方，双臂向两侧平举。
前手掌心向上，向上、向后伸过头顶；后手轻轻滑到后腿上。
前膝保持弯曲，侧腰拉长，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，再换侧。
en: Start in Warrior II: feet wide, front knee bent over the ankle and arms out to the sides.
Turn the front palm up and reach it up and back overhead; let the back hand slide lightly down the back leg.
Keep the front knee bent and the side waist long; breathe steadily for the set time, then switch sides.

zh: 后手只是轻放在腿上，不要压着腿支撑身体。
en: Rest the back hand lightly on the leg; do not lean your weight on it.

zh: 双脚分开约一条腿长，脚尖向外转约 45 度。
屈膝下蹲，膝盖朝向脚尖方向打开，髋部下沉到舒适高度；双手合十在胸前，或屈肘举起。
尾骨自然向下，胸口上提，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，再伸直双腿起身。
en: Step your feet about a leg-length apart and turn the toes out about 45 degrees.
Bend the knees in line with the toes and lower the hips to a comfortable height; bring the palms together at the chest or raise bent arms.
Let the tailbone point down and lift the chest; breathe steadily for the set time, then straighten the legs to rise.

zh: 膝盖始终对准脚尖方向，不要向内扣。
en: Keep the knees tracking over the toes; do not let them cave inwards.

zh: 双膝跪地，身体直立；一条腿向侧面伸直，脚掌踩地，脚尖朝前。
同侧手轻放在伸直的腿上，另一侧手臂向上伸，越过头顶向伸直腿方向侧弯。
胸口保持朝前，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，回正后换侧。
en: Kneel upright, then extend one leg straight out to the side with the foot flat and toes forwards.
Rest the same-side hand on the straight leg and reach the other arm up and over towards it into a side bend.
Keep the chest facing forwards; breathe steadily for the set time, come back upright and switch sides.

zh: 膝下可以垫毛巾或叠起的垫子。
en: Pad the kneeling knee with a towel or folded mat if needed.

zh: 双脚前后分开约一条腿长，前脚尖朝前，后脚略向内转，两侧髋部都朝前。
背部拉长，从髋部向前俯身；后侧手放到前脚旁的地面、瑜伽砖或小腿上，另一手向上伸，胸口转向前腿一侧。
平稳呼吸保持规定时间，松开扭转再起身，换侧。
en: Step the feet about a leg-length apart, front toes forwards and back foot turned slightly in, both hips facing forwards.
Lengthen the back and hinge forwards; place the opposite hand by the front foot, on a block or on the shin, reach the other arm up and turn the chest towards the front leg.
Breathe steadily for the set time, release the twist before rising, then switch sides.

zh: 够不到地面就用瑜伽砖或扶小腿，转动幅度以背部舒服为准。
en: Use a block or the shin if the floor is far; twist only as far as the back feels comfortable.

zh: 从高位新月式开始：前膝弯曲在脚踝正上方，后脚跟抬起。
双手胸前合十，身体转向前腿一侧，把对侧手肘放到前膝外侧。
脊柱拉长，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，回正后换侧。
en: Start in a high crescent lunge: front knee bent over the ankle, back heel lifted.
Bring the palms together at the chest and turn towards the front leg, hooking the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Keep the spine long and breathe steadily for the set time, come back to centre and switch sides.

zh: 后膝可以落地降低难度。
en: Lower the back knee to the floor to make it easier.

zh: 从站立前屈开始，对侧手放在支撑脚前方的地面或瑜伽砖上。
重心移到支撑腿上，另一条腿向后抬到与地面大致平行，胸口转向支撑腿一侧，另一手向上伸。
平稳呼吸保持规定时间，先放下手臂和抬起的腿，再换侧。
en: From a standing forward bend, place the opposite hand on the floor or a block in front of the standing foot.
Shift onto the standing leg, lift the other leg back to about hip height, turn the chest towards the standing-leg side and reach the other arm up.
Breathe steadily for the set time, lower the arm and lifted leg first, then switch sides.

zh: 在墙边练习，下方的手一直有支撑；失去平衡就先放下抬起的腿。
en: Practise near a wall with the lower hand always supported; lower the lifted leg first if you lose balance.

zh: 站稳，一侧膝盖抬向胸前，同侧手握住大脚趾、脚掌外侧或绕在脚上的毛巾。
在舒适范围内把腿向前伸直，支撑腿保持伸直，骨盆摆正。
平稳呼吸保持规定时间，屈膝放下，再换侧。
en: Stand tall, draw one knee towards the chest and hold the big toe, the outer foot or a towel looped around the foot.
Extend the leg forwards as far as is comfortable, keeping the standing leg straight and the pelvis level.
Breathe steadily for the set time, bend the knee to release, then switch sides.

zh: 抬起的腿可以保持弯曲；需要时一手扶墙或椅背。
en: Keep the lifted knee bent if needed; hold a wall or chair back for support.

zh: 山式站立，双脚踩稳，手臂放在身体两侧。
吸气时双臂从两侧向上举过头顶，掌心相对，肩膀远离耳朵。
肋骨下收、身体向上拉长，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，呼气放下手臂。
en: Stand in Mountain Pose with the feet grounded and the arms by your sides.
Inhale and sweep the arms out and up overhead, palms facing, shoulders away from the ears.
Draw the ribs in and lengthen upwards; breathe steadily for the set time, then exhale and lower the arms.

zh: 肩膀不舒服时把手臂分开得宽一些，或只举到肩高。
en: If the shoulders complain, take the arms wider or lift them only to shoulder height.

zh: 坐在垫子上，双腿并拢向前伸直，脚尖回勾。
双手放在髋部两侧的地面上，坐骨踩稳，从骨盆向上坐高。
肩膀放松下沉，平稳呼吸保持规定时间。
en: Sit on the mat with the legs together and straight in front, toes drawn back.
Place the hands on the floor beside the hips, root through the sit bones and sit up tall from the pelvis.
Relax the shoulders down and breathe steadily for the set time.

zh: 背部容易弓起时，坐在叠起的毯子上或微屈膝。
en: If the back rounds, sit on a folded blanket or bend the knees slightly.

zh: 坐姿，一侧小腿横放在身前，与垫子前缘平行。
另一侧小腿叠放在上面，脚踝在下方膝盖外侧，两只脚都回勾。
从髋部坐高，可以略向前倾；平稳呼吸保持规定时间，再换上下腿。
en: Sit and place one shin across the front of the mat, parallel to the front edge.
Stack the other shin on top so the ankle rests just outside the lower knee, both feet flexed.
Sit tall from the hips and lean forwards slightly if you like; breathe steadily for the set time, then switch legs.

zh: 膝盖有任何不适就松开，在上方膝盖下面垫瑜伽砖或毯子。
en: Release at any knee discomfort; support the top knee with a block or blanket.

name.en: Half Lord of the Fishes Pose

zh: 坐姿，双膝弯曲；一侧脚放到对侧臀部外侧地面，另一只脚跨过这条腿，脚掌踩在膝盖外侧。
吸气坐高，呼气时转向立起的膝盖，对侧手臂抱住或用手肘抵住膝盖，另一手放在身后地面。
每次吸气拉长脊柱，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，回正后换侧。
en: Sit with both knees bent; tuck one foot beside the opposite hip and step the other foot across, flat on the floor outside that knee.
Inhale to sit tall; exhale and turn towards the raised knee, hugging it or hooking the opposite elbow outside it, other hand on the floor behind you.
Lengthen the spine on each inhale and breathe steadily for the set time; come back to centre and switch sides.

zh: 下方的腿可以伸直；转动从胸背开始，不要用手臂硬拉。
en: The lower leg may stay straight; turn from the upper back rather than levering with the arm.

zh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手在肩膀正下方，身体成一条直线。
身体略向前移，屈肘贴近身体，缓慢下降到上臂与地面大致平行。
保持规定时间，再放低到地面或推回平板。
en: Start in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in one line.
Shift slightly forwards and bend the elbows close to your sides, lowering until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Hold for the set time, then lower to the floor or press back to plank.

zh: 双膝落地可以降低难度；肩膀不要低于手肘。
en: Drop the knees to make it easier; do not let the shoulders sink below the elbows.

zh: 从平板支撑把双膝落到地面。
屈肘贴近身体，胸口和下巴放到双手之间的地面上，臀部保持抬起。
平稳呼吸保持规定时间，再向前滑入眼镜蛇式或推回四点跪姿。
en: From plank, lower both knees to the floor.
Bend the elbows close to your sides and lower the chest and chin to the floor between the hands, hips still lifted.
Breathe steadily for the set time, then slide forwards into Cobra or press back to hands and knees.

zh: 下巴只是轻触地面，颈部不要承重。
en: Let the chin touch lightly; do not put weight through the neck.

zh: 四点跪姿，在双膝下垫毛巾或叠起的垫子。
双膝慢慢向两侧分开，小腿与大腿约成直角，脚踝与膝盖对齐。
降到前臂支撑，髋部轻轻向后移；平稳呼吸保持规定时间，再把双膝收回。
en: Come to hands and knees with towels or a folded mat under the knees.
Slowly widen the knees out to the sides, shins at right angles to the thighs and ankles in line with the knees.
Lower onto the forearms and ease the hips back; breathe steadily for the set time, then draw the knees back together.

zh: 大腿内侧只要有轻微拉长感就够了，膝盖有不适就收小分开的距离。
en: A gentle inner-thigh stretch is enough; narrow the knees if they feel any discomfort.

zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚踩地。
脚底相对，让双膝慢慢向两侧落下；可以在大腿外侧垫枕头或瑜伽砖。
双手放在腹部或身体两侧，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，用手帮助把双膝收回。
en: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet on the floor.
Bring the soles together and let the knees fall open to the sides; support the outer thighs with cushions or blocks if you like.
Rest the hands on the belly or by your sides and breathe steadily for the set time; use your hands to bring the knees back together.

zh: 腹股沟有拉扯感时，在膝下多垫一些支撑。
en: Add more support under the knees if the groin feels strained.

zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直；把毛巾或伸展带绕在一只脚的脚掌上。
双手握住两端，把这条腿向上抬到大腿后侧有轻微拉长感，另一条腿贴地。
肩膀放松，平稳呼吸保持规定时间，屈膝放下后换侧。
en: Lie on your back with the legs straight and loop a towel or strap around one foot.
Hold both ends and raise that leg until you feel a gentle stretch along the back of the thigh, the other leg resting on the floor.
Relax the shoulders and breathe steadily for the set time; bend the knee to lower, then switch sides.

zh: 地面上的腿可以弯曲，脚踩地。
en: The leg on the floor may bend with the foot flat.

zh: 从英雄坐开始：跪坐在双脚之间，可以坐在瑜伽砖或叠起的毯子上。
双手撑在身后，慢慢把身体向后放低到前臂，或靠在身后竖放的枕头上。
平稳呼吸保持规定时间，用手臂撑回坐姿，再伸直双腿。
en: Begin in Hero Pose, sitting between the feet; sit on a block or folded blanket if you like.
Place the hands behind you and slowly lean back onto the forearms or onto a bolster set behind you.
Breathe steadily for the set time, press up on the arms to sit, then straighten the legs.

zh: 膝盖或下背有任何不适就停在前臂撑地，或换成仰卧束角式。
en: Stop on the forearms, or choose Reclined Bound Angle instead, at any knee or low-back discomfort.

zh: 深蹲到脚尖着地，双膝并拢，上身转向一侧，双手在身体侧面撑地，与肩同宽。
屈肘形成小平台，把外侧大腿放到上臂上，身体向前倾。
重心慢慢移到双手，让双脚离地；保持规定时间，双脚落地后换侧。
en: Squat on the balls of the feet with the knees together, twist to one side and plant the hands shoulder-width apart beside you.
Bend the elbows to make a shelf, rest the outer thigh on the upper arm and lean forwards.
Shift weight into the hands until the feet lift; hold for the set time, lower the feet and switch sides.

zh: 在脸前方放一个枕头；先只抬起一只脚练习。
en: Place a cushion in front of your face and practise lifting one foot at a time first.

zh: 山式站立，吸气上举式，呼气站立前屈。
吸气半前屈，呼气后退到平板并降到四柱支撑或八体投地，吸气上犬式或眼镜蛇式。
呼气下犬式停留 3–5 次呼吸，再走回站立前屈，吸气上举式，呼气回到山式。一轮结束。
en: Stand in Mountain Pose; inhale to Upward Salute, exhale to Standing Forward Bend.
Inhale to a half lift; exhale, step back to plank and lower through Four-Limbed Staff or Knees-Chest-Chin; inhale to Upward Dog or Cobra.
Exhale to Downward Dog for 3–5 breaths, walk forwards to the forward bend, inhale to Upward Salute and exhale back to Mountain. That is one round.

zh: 按自己的呼吸节奏做，动作之间不着急；下降时可以先双膝落地。
en: Move at the pace of your breath without rushing; lower with the knees down if needed.

zh: 吸气屈膝进入幻椅式，呼气站立前屈，吸气半前屈。
呼气降到四柱支撑，吸气上犬式，呼气下犬式；右脚向前迈，吸气战士一式，再回到下犬式；左侧重复一次。
在下犬式停留 3–5 次呼吸，走回前屈，吸气幻椅式，呼气站立。一轮结束。
en: Inhale, bend the knees into Chair Pose; exhale to Standing Forward Bend; inhale to a half lift.
Exhale through Four-Limbed Staff, inhale to Upward Dog, exhale to Downward Dog; step the right foot forwards into Warrior I, flow back to Downward Dog, then repeat on the left.
Stay in Downward Dog for 3–5 breaths, walk forwards to the fold, inhale to Chair and exhale to stand. That is one round.

zh: 先熟悉拜日式 A；下降时可以先双膝落地，幻椅式不必蹲太低。
en: Get comfortable with Sun Salutation A first; lower with the knees down if needed and keep Chair Pose shallow.
